title: Jets lose John Simpson and Nick Folk in free agency

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets lose John Simpson and Nick Folk in free agency
sources.description: Free agency has begun in the NFL with the start of the legal tampering period. It isn’t necessarily the biggest surprise, but a pair of Jets free agents have agreed to deals with new teams. Guard John Simpson is returning to Baltimore on a three year contract.
